module: Flowgraph node "Parking Spot" (category repeat_instant). Decomposes a parking spot (parkingSpotData): outputs name, pos, rot (quat), scl (vec3). Option data.fixedHeight (>0) overrides the height of scl. Dynamic pins expose the custom fields (options, default "key").

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's own settings from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the node's own settings to the `res` table when saving the graph.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

postInit.desc: Called after the node's pins are created; used to adjust the pins (value templates, file filters, dynamic keys).

updateKeys.desc: Rebuilds the dynamic output pins from the node's options list.

work.desc: Copies the spot's name, position, rotation and scale to the outputs, applies fixedHeight if > 0 and reads the custom fields.
